messages.content: Tell me about the Octane Green support retainer package.

For entry-level system support, we offer the Octane Green (formerly Red) retainer. This package delivers 24/7 support and 15 support hours per month. It excludes project-based work, advanced reporting, and rollover hours. Billing follows the standard Green retainer tier.
